propositions: The documented curl command to install the Gerrit commit-msg hook uses git rev-parse --git-path which resolves to the shared hooks directory in the main checkout even when run from a linked worktree, causing silent clobbering of the pre-commit wrapper for all worktrees on the host.

Running the documented install from a linked worktree breaks Change-Id stamping silently until a push to Gerrit is attempted from a different worktree, creating a delayed and distributed failure mode.

The pre-commit migration chain expects commit-msg hook installations to preserve the wrapper and chain to commit-msg.legacy, but the documented curl directly overwrites the wrapper instead of chaining to it.

The fix consolidates Gerrit hook installation into scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh and make hooks to provide one idempotent documented path that is cwd-independent, non-destructive, payload-validating, and refuses unsafe overwrites.
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must be updated to remove the unsafe bare curl command and direct users to make hooks instead.
